"''If this is a consular ship, where is the Ambassador?|Captain Antilles and Darth Vader, shortly before the latter kills the former|}} The '''''Tantive IV''''' {{Pronounced|ˈtæntɪˌvi 'fɔ:r}} was a [[CR90 corvette]] in the service of the [[House of Organa]]. The ship was a central player in the events at the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War]], serving as [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] personal [[starship]] in the leadup to the [[Battle of Yavin]]. [[Standard decade|Decades]] later, the vessel would play a crucial role during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]] when it took part in the climactic [[Battle of Exegol]]. During the battle, the ''Tantive IV'' was destroyed by [[Darth Sidious]]' [[Force lightning]] attack. ==Description== [[File:Acme-DarkEntrance.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and four [[Stormtrooper]]s in a hallway aboard the ''Tantive IV'']] The [[starship]]'s [[hull]] was mainly [[color]]ed white, as with many [[CR90 corvette]]s,Many, if not all, depictions of CR90 corvettes show a mainly white color scheme. Sources include the ''[[Epic Battles Multiplayer Expansion]]'' cover art and all instances of such vessels in ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. and distinctly painted with dark red lines. The interior walls of the craft's corridors and chambers were also adorned in a similar fashion, excluding the maintenance shafts lined with the [[escape pod]]s, which bore bare pipes without any paneling. As a vessel of state, the ship featured dining rooms for hosting state dinners, as well as conference centers suitable for negotiations with interstellar dignitaries.''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] had a personal office aboard.[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] A cluster of structures was present between the stern's eleven engines and the central section topped with four cannons. This cluster sported a ventral{{TCW|Supply Lines}} passenger entrance [[Turbolift|lift]]{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/supply-lines-concept-art-gallery|text="Supply Lines" Concept Art Gallery}} that extended onto a landing platform, from which passengers descended. Atop this tower was another affixed cannon. Between the central structure and the [[cockpit]] located at the head of the corvette was a cannon tower that protruded both upwards and downwards. The ''Tantive IV'' also carried four 8-passenger-capacity escape pods, in addition to eight smaller, 4-passenger-capacity ones. ==History== ===Alderaanian Corvette=== The ship was used by Bail as a mobile headquarters during his duties as the [[senator]] of [[Alderaan]], during and after the [[Clone Wars]]. Organa took it to [[Toydaria]] in order to [[The Matter of Using Toydarian Territory to Aid the Shipment of Relief Supplies to the Citizens of Ryloth|negotiate]] with [[King]] [[Katuunko]] about the possibility of using his world as a staging ground for a [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] supply mission to [[Ryloth]]. [[18 BBY|One year]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], it was briefly broken into by [[Ahsoka Tano]] in her quest to speak with Bail. She had [[R2-D2]]'s assistance in this, as the [[astromech droid]] secretly opened one of the [[corvette]]'s [[airlock]]s so Ahsoka, wearing a [[Environment suit|spacesuit]], could slip inside. It later assisted with the [[Raada Uprising|evacuation]] of [[Raada]]. [[File:TantiveIVToydaria-SL.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Tantive IV'' [[Hangar|docked]] on Toydaria]] In [[5 BBY]], the [[Spectres]] returned [[C-3PO]] and R2-D2 to Bail aboard the ''Tantive IV''. The two [[droid]]s had been on a [[Mission to steal Imperial weapons|mission]] to prevent a shipment of [[T-7 ion disruptor rifle]]s from falling into Imperial hands, and had encountered the ''[[Ghost]]'' crew in the process.{{Rebels|Droids in Distress}} When [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] turned sixteen and had her [[Leia Organa's Day of Demand|Day of Demand]], she was able to requisition the ship for use on relief missions. She took the ''Tantive IV'' on her first mission, to [[Wobani]], where she wound up evacuating 100 [[refugee]]s under the pretense of hiring them as crew for the corvette, unwittingly destroying Bail's secret negotiations to relocate the suffering [[planet]]'s population. Leia took the vessel on several more missions while completing her [[Challenge of the Heart]], including to the planets [[Chasmeene]] and [[Chal Hudda]]. During this [[time]], Bail still used the ship for rebel business, including to the [[Rebel base (Paucris)|rebel base]] at [[Paucris Major]]. The [[Viceroy]] [[Evacuation of Paucris Major|evacuated]] from Paucris in the ''Tantive IV'' after Leia arrived warning of the impending arrival of an [[Imperial Navy|Imperial fleet]] in the [[Paucris system|system]]. ===Galactic Civil War=== {{Quote|I survived as a prisoner, first aboard Vader's Star Destroyer and then aboard the Death Star. I never learned the fates of the others.|Leia recounting the crew of the ''Tantive IV'' decades later|''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''}}
[[File:Vader_beast_mode.png|thumb|250px|Darth Vader, seeking the Death Star plans]]
Shortly before the [[Battle of Scarif]], the ''Tantive IV'' was on a mission in which it was severely damaged, requiring extensive repairs to its [[hyperdrive]], [[engine]]s and weapons. It was in the drydock aboard the ''[[Profundity]]'' undergoing those repairs when the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|rebel fleet]] was forced to scramble to [[Scarif]] for a turning-point battle.{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View}} Leia had boarded the corvette with the intention of traveling to [[Tatooine]] to meet with the [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]] [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the battle breaking out before she could leave. Near the end of the battle, the ''Profundity'' was boarded by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] as he slaughtered many rebels. After securing the stolen [[Death Star plans|schematics]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], the ''Tantive IV'' barely managed to launch from the crippled Rebel [[flagship]] and escape the battle with the plans before Vader could board it to recover them.''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' The crippling of the flagship also damaged the corvette's own electrical grid, leading to its shields and weapons being only partially available. The ''Tantive IV'' immediately set course to Tatooine. The crew did everything in its power to keep the ship running due to the damage, which complicated their escape; while jumps to [[lightspeed]] generally left a ship untraceable, the ship's damaged hyperdrive left a unique energy signature that the Empire could follow. Unknown to all, the [[protocol droid]] [[U-3PO]] had also been secretly reprogrammed by the Empire to serve as an unwitting [[spy]] amongst the [[House of Organa]]. As the droid happened to be aboard the ''Tantive IV'', the Empire could also track the droid to find the ship.{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}} [[File:Devastatortantiveiv.png|thumb|left|220px|Pursued by the ''Devastator'']] [[Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles]] planned to ditch the corvette on Tatooine and acquire a new ship to complete their journey. Eight [[Standard minute|minutes]]—three-quarters of a [[parsec]]—short of their destination, their [[hyperdrive motivator]] gave out, and the ''Tantive IV'' was intercepted by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]''. In the following [[Secret mission to Tatooine|battle]], the main [[reactor]] of the ''Tantive IV'' was shut down, and Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s cut apart the door and boarded the ship, gunning down many of the Rebels, as R2-D2 and C-3PO fled. Antilles gave the order for the civilians aboard to launch in the escape pod. After her capture, Princess Leia briefly spotted the ship docked within one of the hangars of the ''Devastator''.''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' During the battle, R2-D2 and C-3PO, the former carrying the stolen plans, escaped to Tatooine on one of the ship's escape pods. [[Gunnery captain]] [[Bolvan]] ordered [[Lieutenant]] [[Hija]] to not fire on the escape pod after detecting it carried no life-forms.{{StoryCite|story=The Sith of Datawork|book=From a Certain Point of View}} On those same orders, Lieutenant [[Ciena Ree]] also relented from destroying the pod. Bolvan had thought destroying a target without life-forms would harm a possible promotion due to a lack of kills. Upon realizing the escape pod likely contained the plans, Bolvan and [[Fleet logistics liaison]] [[Arvira]] conspired to cover up his failing by shifting the blame. The Empire then announced that the corvette had been destroyed in a catastrophic meteor collision.''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]'' ===Lost=== {{Quote|The Tantive is lost. Destroyed.|Bail Organa, to his wife, Breha Organa|{{StoryCite|story=Eclipse (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}}}} When Bail Organa returned to Alderaan, following the news of the [[dissolution of the Imperial Senate]], he told his [[Marriage|wife]], [[Queen]] [[Breha Organa]], that the ''Tantive'' had been lost, presuming that their daughter was dead. Breha, however, refused to believe the tragic news and over the next few days she and her husband would send out scouts to try to recover the wreckage. In their final moments they reassured one another that Leia was alive. [[Standard decade|Decades]] after the [[Imperial Instruments of Surrender|end]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]], Leia, now leading the [[Resistance]] [[Cold War|against]] the [[First Order]], recounted her experiences, thinking that she never learned what happened to the crew of the ''Tantive IV''. ===Return and destruction=== Many years after the end of the Galactic Civil War, a former Imperial senator discovered the remains of the ''Tantive IV'' lying derelict in a hangar in the [[Yarma system]]. Sympathetic to Leia's cause, the senator repaired the former consular ship and returned it to her as a gift. Leia used the vessel as her personal flagship from the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on [[Ajan Kloss]].''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' [[File:Resistance_fleet_Ep_IX.png|thumb|220px|The ''Tantive IV'' alongside the Resistance fleet during the battle on Exegol.]] Given the lack of barracks on the moon, most of the Resistance support crew lived and slept aboard the ''Tantive IV'' when not on duty; it was also used as a generator for the Resistance base. In [[35 ABY]], the starship was used by the Resistance in the [[Battle of Exegol|decisive battle]] against the [[Sith Eternal]] on [[Exegol]] and was piloted by [[Nien Nunb]] and [[Urcos Furdam]] during the battle. It was briefly disabled when [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] released a storm of [[Force lightning|lightning]] into the air, alongside the rest of the fleet.{{Film|IX}} The attack destroyed one of its engines, setting off numerous secondary explosions and sending it plummeting to Exegol's surface as General Dameron watched in horror, resulting in the loss of the ship along with all hands aboard. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Tantive IV'' first appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], and holds the distinction of being the first ever ship to appear in the franchise. The design of the ship was originally to be used for the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', but it was found that both the name and the spacecraft were too similar to the [[W:c:moonbasealpha:Eagle Transporter|Eagle Transporter]] from concurrent television series [[W:c:moonbasealpha:Space: 1999 (Series)|''Space: 1999'']]. Thus it was modified and used for the ''Tantive IV'', which had less screen time and didn't have a bird-related name. ==Appearances== {{ScrollBox|
